verdict.rationale: Runpod is a GPU cloud, so choosing data region or residency is a fair question, but the evidence pack never documents a user choosing where data is stored. The marketing line "Thousands of GPUs across 30+ regions" and the network-volume docs show only that regions and persistent storage exist. Nothing shows a selectable storage region or any residency guarantee.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
